key_catalyst: Amazon Q2 beat with AWS acceleration, +9.5% after hours, landing on top of Microsoft's blowout cloud print and a broad chip rebound — megacap AI/cloud results now being bought rather than sold.
reasoning: Track B applies: megacap AI/cloud earnings is the dominant recurring theme (present in 9 of the last 10 days) and its recent responses are DOWN-dominant (2 UP / 5 DOWN / 2 FLAT), so it is not ignorable on familiarity alone — but today falls squarely in the 'clearly resolving' carve-out of that rule. The specific sub-leg that produced those DOWN days (unrebutted AI-spending doubt, and good megacap/chip news being sold) reversed on the most recent print: Microsoft's blowout cloud result plus a calendar-2026 capex cut to ~$175B was bought for +1.30%, the largest intraday gain in the entire memory window, and Amazon's AWS-driven beat (+9.5% after hours) extends that confirmation while the memory/semi complex rallies with it (SanDisk +24%) instead of fading. The negatives in the window are single-name and second-order (Meta EPS miss with higher capex/legal costs, Apple Services and China softness), no geopolitical or oil item printed in this window at all, and the FOMC item is a stale recap of an already-resolved hold — nothing here is a new catalyst that clears the SELL bar, and the cool-down from yesterday's wrong SELL points the same way.
